lines: At dawn, the dark clouds loosen from the sky
Clear light falls on every field and stone
Step forward on the open road before you
And turn the life you have into your own
The season turns; the first flowers stir
The peony gathers color at the root
When spring arrives, let its clear winds find you
What frost held down will rise and flower anew
Steady your heart; let empty fears depart
Your share of bread and clothing will endure
When hands join hands, good fortune fills the house
In time, a hidden pearl will reach the shore
The wind is calm; the river lies at rest
A harvest moon hangs round above the prow
Let anxious thoughts drift past like fallen leaves
Blessing has already reached your household now
The road ahead may change where its turns lie
Move early, before the rising waters swell
Stay by the long river till its storms pass by
And guard yourself wherever you may dwell
Rain pours in sheets across the restless plain
A troubled season can wound what once was strong
If you must leave your home and travel far
Carry your courage with you all along
The clouds draw back; the bright moon clears the way
No need to question where your footsteps lead
A destined bond is written in the heart
When two hearts join, good fortune follows them
The rice bends low beneath its ripened grain
The work is whole; its promise has come true
Go home and rest among the smiling faces
Your household's joy is the harvest waiting there
A dragon and a tiger meet in mountain shade
Do not look back to read what lies behind
Some paths cross only for a little while
Release the parting, and keep peace of mind
Half of the blossom has already set fruit
Half has withered before the summer's heat
The setting sun has shortened this year's light
Do not pursue a road that leads nowhere
The rooster's call grows clearer through the mist
Let time reveal what waiting hours conceal
The clouds divide; the moon shines over all
And peace arrives when truth is made clear
The long river settles, wave by wave, at last
A helping hand appears beyond the bend
Move forward now; the danger has passed by
The farther bank opens like a trusted friend
Your boat has reached a shallow, rocky bar
No skillful oar can make the current yield
Lay frantic schemes aside and read the water
The wiser course will soon reveal itself
The ledgers clear as spring flowers fade
Fruit forms where blossoms once adorned the tree
Wait beneath the moon; let osmanthus scent the air
Patient work will bring its harvest there
The old fisherman waits through eighty years
Then King Wen comes walking to the shore
Do not force the hour with anxious questions
Keep hold of hope; your season is not over
No incense tower can make a closed door yield
The law of heaven is not a thing to buy
Lay down the schemes that wear your daylight thin
Walk upright beneath the unrelenting sky
Old grievances still gather in the home
Yet no misfortune has crossed the eaves
Do good with care, and keep watch at the gate
When dragon meets snake, old hatred loosens
A fortunate star is rising on your road
A noble helper may unlock the gate
Speak plainly, and let both sides understand
Joined hands can turn delay to good fortune
Your fortune follows paths no pride can bend
High hopes can stumble when they outrun sense
Return to roads your wiser steps remember
The moon will light them, and your heart find rest
The road to honor meets a tangled snare
Two families risk a loss they cannot bear
Step back before a spark becomes a flame
A prudent retreat can keep the household safe
The Buddha's light shines through the troubled sky
The red sun reaches every waiting door
A gracious helper comes with open hands
And fear that lived within is there no more
Tai-gong found success at eighty years
The moon then lit the four seas, broad and bright
Great fortune can enter a thatched-roof home
When patient work has kept the spirit right
The river runs wide, but the road is not yet clear
Your fishing line still rests within your hand
Do not despair because the waters seem empty
The fish will meet you when the tide is right
Moonlight shines across the four seas tonight
The cloud that hid your road is thinning fast
A peaceful place and honor wait ahead
Keep faith; the hardship will not last
Do not exhaust yourself by asking signs
Let dogs bark at the gate; let days pass by
The answer comes when needless questions cease
A quiet heart can read the open sky
The finest peony opens in the sun
Take its bright chance before the season turns
A fated meeting may begin with one glance
Spring favors the heart that dares to love
A clear wind circles gently round the gate
The household rests in peace, untouched by care
Let honest wealth gather within the home
No louder prayer is stronger than a peaceful home
The fallen tiger hears the village dogs bark
The mountain road winds slowly through the rain
Do not let this low hour define your life
Beyond the ridges, sunlight comes again
The withered tree still shelters spring within
For now it sleeps beneath the winter frost
Wait till the bitter winds have spent their force
Then green shoots show that nothing has been lost
The moon grows brighter through the drifting haze
Yet changing light warns that the climb goes on
Do not mistake one shining night for dawn
Prepare your hands; hard work will earn its praise
Green willows flourish beside the flowing stream
The orchard sets its fruit in quiet grace
Let your household share the harvest patiently grown
And pass its blessing from hand to hand
A dragon and a tiger meet beside the gate
What looked like gold may turn to iron soon
Do not trust charms to change the turn of fate
Keep honest hands beneath the changing moon
The river spreads wide, yet your boat holds true
No sudden wind has troubled oar or sail
Renew the quiet good within your household
The fish will meet your line when tides prevail
The dangerous mountain road is almost passed
Do not resent the ridges climbed with pain
When orchids and laurels bloom along the trail
The little snake will rise and turn into a dragon
No need to force the turns that lie ahead
A stubborn knot gives way when hearts agree
Make room for peace to enter through your door
And trouble will recede like the morning sea
Your blessings stretch as far as the eastern sea
May your long years stand firm as mountains stand
Why dwell on hardship when good fortune comes
Keep faith beneath the shelter of your home
A turn of fortune brings a brighter name
The road ahead is open, free of harm
Choose firmly now and seize the favorable hour
A steadfast heart will keep the future calm
Your name is rising in the morning light
No need to pray for proof when fortune nears
The hours move quickly through the eastern trees
Act in your good time and quiet all fears
If the immortal's road is hidden, climb the tower
A higher view can make the tangled path clear
Wait calmly while a worthy helper draws near
Patience will meet the helping hand in time
Good fortune fills your household through the years
Your family gate shines with enduring light
Let husband and wife share joy through every season
Together, grow old in peace and delight
The road is hard, yet songs arise nearby
A barking dog announces news at hand
Some bonds were joined before this lifetime began
A lasting pair will meet and understand
One river crossing leads to one more hill
The road is hard, whatever path you try
Do not let disputes disturb the household peace
Peace begins when angry words run dry
This year's affairs have flown by in haste
The noble helper waits a thousand miles away
Be patient; news will come beneath the moon
And bring good tidings to your home one day
A visitor may bring you gain and cheer
Why meet a friendly guest with needless doubt
The moon will rise and clear the road ahead
When light appears, all hesitation fades out
The blossom has matured into its fruit
Prosperity will stay with you through age
Let wise and foolish meet without disdain
A calm heart welcomes blessings year by year
Your name and honor rise beneath the moon
The road to wealth now opens clear and bright
When the full moon crowns the fifteenth night
Joy and reunion fill your home with light
Why ask the gods when wisdom lives within
Wait till the moon reaches its middle course
The trouble will retreat and turn to good
And fortune will return with gentle force
The moon is dim behind a veil of cloud
The wish to move is strong, but fortune lags
Do not force the gate before it opens wide
When time is ripe, the road will lift its flags
Many words are spoken; do not heed them all
The dragon rests where quiet waters lie
A message hidden now will soon grow clear
Ask no more; the truth will meet your eye
Before the shrine, keep faith with your vow
Good news lies waiting on the road ahead
What once was iron may become bright gold
Stay true, and fortune will turn iron to gold
No road to east or west is safe today
Yet your household stands protected and secure
Hold steady; do not let your heart grow troubled
Within your home, peace and health endure
Your work and rank depend on time and fate
The winds converge; a meeting point is near
Release your anxious thoughts and ready both hands
A timely chance will soon appear
You come to ask about the matters of your heart
A home that does good gathers lasting grace
Good fortune and wealth arrive together soon
Joy will overflow the doorway of your place
A lonely lamp burns through the silent night
Yet every matter moves toward a fortunate end
Good deeds bear fruit even when no one sees
And incense carried heavenward will reach the gods
The road ahead is dim, and signs are hard to read
A pearl deep underground still keeps its worth
Do not mistake delay for failure's final word
Guard what you hold till fortune brings it forth
Though illness tests you with exhausting pain
The worst will pass and leave no lasting scar
Do not look back once you have gone your way
The troubles in your heart will fade afar
Steady your heart; let needless fear depart
The road ahead is clear and free of harm
A guardian spirit watches o'er your home
Good fortune keeps your household safe and calm
The serpent longs to rise and become a dragon
But blocked roads keep its fortune from advancing
Do not follow every word that fills the air
Wait through the long illness; better days are coming
Do good without delay when chance appears
This is the season to seek a worthy name
The matter will be joined and brought to fruit
Wealth and gladness will follow in its wake
The moon shines clear beyond the drifting cloud
Keep doing good within your household walls
In public duty, careful judgment brings reward
And hidden trouble fades as brighter fortune calls
